Chhattisgarh Cities Win National Swachh Survekshan Awards

In the Swachh Survekshan 2023 awards, Chhattisgarh's Bilha secured the first position nationwide. Raipur and Bilaspur also received national honors. The awards recognize the achievements of these cities in sanitation.
